source_grounding.note: Every file matching grep 'delete_collection' across lib/ and src/ was either read or confirmed an unrelated/child call site. The 200+result:false behavior is an explicit, commented code path (idempotent-style delete: Ok(false) means 'nothing was deleted'), not a missing validation. It nonetheless flatly contradicts the contract's 'DELETE missing => 404' clause — implementation vs contract-text divergence for the auditor to weigh, with the doc layer siding with the implementation.
